name: vicoop-codex
description: OpenAI Codex agent driven via the `vicoop-codex` CLI. Each A2A task streams an OpenAI Chat Completions request (assembled from the openai-compat A2A extension) through a shared local `vicoop-codex serve` instance, emitting the model's response token-by-token as incremental A2A artifacts plus an openai-compat usage / chat_completion envelope on the final message metadata.

extensions.description: Reads the full OpenAI Chat Completions request envelope (chat_completions_request) from the openai-compat A2A metadata and forwards it to the vicoop-codex CLI; surfaces the model's response (text, tool_calls, usage) as a complete OpenAI ChatCompletion envelope echoed on the final A2A message's metadata under the extension URI (chat_completion key).

skills.name: chat
skills.description: Ask a question or give an instruction in natural language; the vicoop-codex CLI responds with text. Auxiliary structured context can be attached as A2A `data` parts; they are serialized into the prompt as tagged JSON blocks. File parts are not supported.
